Noting that I have removed the tag '682'. To my knowledge, SCPs don't get their own tags. If one wants to propose to have a '682' tag, please do it officially via the Tag Suggestion Thread, instead of adding it in.

After all, if there is only just one article with that particular tag, is it even performing its duty as a tag?

item.content:encoded:
Not really, that scene displays that 343 isn't pissed because 682 did something, he's pissed because something else created it. Think of it like 343 is an artist, he created our whatever and all was jolly for him, then someone went a head and slapped a big ugly blob of ink onto his painting. They ruined his hand crafted piece of art and he hates it, he hates that ugly ink blob and he despises that other artist.

The question isn't "what did 682 do?" it's "who made 682?"

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Actually, it would explain some of what happened in that tale:

"682?" 343 called out, a brief flash of anger in his eyes. Between one moment and the next he is standing in front of me, somehow taller than me without changing his size, glaring down at me. "You brought me to 682?" I motioned behind his back at English, who quickly began the 682 containment procedures, flooding the room with acid.

"Sure did, 343. Got a problem with that?" Anger, from God. With luck, he'd off me, and I wouldn't have to go through with the second part of this test.

Instead, 343 simply turned his back on me. "He's not one of mine. Deal with him yourself." And stalked off through the wall.

He remembered what 682 did, and is still pissed he ate the Ark.

(I know, I know, but it does kind of make sense!)

item.content:encoded:
I'm sorry. This is written well enough, and it's not bad, but I am sick to death of 682. I know it's a sacred cow around here, but what you're essentially left with when people write up all of these supplemental documents is a giant, unkillable monster that hates you. As a concept, it just doesn't work anymore for me.

There's like 1400 articles here, surely we have no shortage of ideas for tales. I can't downvote it, since this is not badly executed at all, but I can't upvote yet another SCP-682 page.
